name: Loopwork
tagline: Soft things, made one loop at a time.
description: Handmade crochet toys, bags, wearables and homeware. Send an order request and pay once we confirm on WhatsApp.

shipping.dispatch: Ready-to-ship pieces leave within 3 working days.
shipping.transit: Most parcels arrive 4–7 working days after dispatch.
shipping.charges: Shipping is worked out from your PIN code and confirmed on WhatsApp before you pay.

pickup.note: Pick up from our studio. We’ll share the address on WhatsApp.

about.alt: Skeins of mint and cream cotton yarn and a crochet hook resting on a ripple blanket

custom.alt: Pink crochet coaster tied with a ribbon on a thank-you card, surrounded by yarn and crochet hooks
